entry.title: Building a Chrome Extension: From Idea to Automated Release
entry.summary:
Chrome extensions are one of the fastest ways to ship useful software. This article walks through how to build a Chrome extension using modern tooling, and how to automate versioning and releases using GitHub Actions. We’ll build a simple Chrome extension with: A content script that interacts with web pages A background script that handles logic and coordination A popup UI for user interaction Automated build, versioning, and GitHub releases Defines metadata, permissions, and entry points. Runs in the context of a web page. Can read and manipulate the DOM. Runs independently of pages. Handles state, messaging, and lifecycle events. A short-lived interface shown when the extension icon is clicked. Chrome extensions are event-driven. Popup -> sends user intent Background -> coordinates logic Content Script -> affects the page
Chrome extensions are commonly distributed using one of the following approaches, depending on the stage of the project. For public distribution, Chrome extensions can be published to the Chrome Web Store. Requires a one-time $5 USD developer registration fee Enables automatic updates Makes the extension discoverable to non-technical users Users install the extension by downloading the release archive and loading it manually in Chrome. Versioned ZIP artifacts Consistent builds No review or approval process No cost As a practical example, I built a Chrome auto-scroller extension and set it up with a fully automated release pipeline using GitHub Actions. A content script that controls page scrolling A popup UI for user interaction A background script for coordination Automated versioned releases on every Git tag https://github.com/Prajwol-Shrestha/auto-scroll-browser-extenstion In this project, releases are automated as follows: A Git tag (e.g. v1.0.1) is pushed GitHub Actions builds the extension The build output is packaged into a ZIP A GitHub Release is created automatically The ZIP is attached as a release asset
